data.one_liner: Monitors network capabilities like bandwidth and signal strength on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides runtime information about the current network such as upstream/downstream bandwidth, signal strength, and transport type. Works on Android (API 29+) and iOS, exposing the data through a simple Dart API.
use_when: You need to adapt UI or logic based on actual network quality
Debugging or logging real‑time network characteristics
Building apps that react to changes in Wi‑Fi vs cellular connectivity
avoid_when: You only need high‑level connectivity status (online/offline)
You require cross‑platform networking without native code
You need extensive streaming or bandwidth management features
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS platforms
weaknesses: Limited to Android Q+ for full feature set
iOS support provides only basic info
data.setup_notes: Add required permissions (e.g., ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE) to AndroidManifest.xml and appropriate keys to iOS Info.plist; ensure the plugin is registered in the host app.
